name: sankathara-chaturthi
description: Tests and checks for the Sankathara Chaturthi site. The site itself has no build step: the files at the repository root are served as they are. Run everything from this folder (cd tests).

scripts.lint: stylelint --config stylelint.config.mjs "../css/**/*.css" && cd .. && eslint -c tests/eslint.config.mjs js content sw.js
scripts.print:audit: rm -rf pdfs && PRINT_AUDIT=1 playwright test print-audit.spec.mjs; node print-audit-report.mjs
